他不由有些着急了：“小哥，你这么不说话了啊？”
他不知道，杨云帆此时正在纠结呢。
痛经是小毛病，揉揉穴位就好了，可是，这个中年大叔明显是肾阴虚，这可不是小毛病，关乎人家一生性福的。
这玩意，随便治疗一下，肯定是不行的，可是，自己又没有那么多时间，给他耐心诊治。
良久没见杨云帆说话，那个中年大叔还以为杨云帆有什么要求，他忙道：“小哥，我走南闯北做生意，也算小有身家。只要能治好这个病，多了不敢说，几万块，我还是出得起的。”
他伸出一只手，五根手指晃了晃，意思是五万块，没问题！
五万块！
卧槽，爷爷我遇到大肥羊了！
杨云帆的眼睛顿时眯了眯，精光闪烁。
麻痹的，小爷以前被老头子扔到山上菜肴打猎，一个月也就从老头子那里拿个几百块，连一顿肉都不敢多吃。
这个死胖子治一个破肾虚的毛病，竟然出五万块！
真是肥羊，不宰他都对不起老天爷给我这个发财的机会！
“不过，等自己去了湘潭市，好像也不缺这五万块钱了。”
“我记得，老爹在湘潭市搞了很大一个企业，不过，等一等，老爹去世很久了……这个企业，现在是谁在管理？”
杨云帆有点记不清楚了。
他被老头子带上山的时候，才五六岁大小。
他依稀记得自己老爹十分有钱，自己的爷爷更是相当有钱。
他们老杨家，祖籍在东海市，在华东一代，相当的有势力。
不过，家族产业发展的很快，渐渐的也在湘潭市有了布局，当初是他老爹负责湘潭市的项目，还有一个合作伙伴，好像叫……叶叔叔？

想到这里，杨云帆却是故意拿乔了一番道：“你这毛病，我学艺不精，可不敢给你治。不过，我师父是一代国手名医，治你这毛病，那就跟张飞吃豆芽一样，小菜一碟！”
果然，国手名医四个字一出，那胖子心中得意无比，没错吧，果然被我猜中了！这位小哥身后有高人了。这次，我的肾虚终于能治好了！等治好了肾虚，胖爷我要第一时间去天上人间，点三个最性感的小妞！
他装出一副恍然大悟的表情，露出崇敬的眼神道：“怪不得小哥你本事那么厉害！”
于是，那胖子恭恭敬敬的问杨云帆，他师父何人，在哪里行医。
杨云帆嘿嘿一笑，把老头子的地址递上去。反正老头子在那一带也是个名医，而且十分有名。看老头子日子过得好像颇为拮据，自己送个土豪给他宰一下，也算对得起他这么多年养育教导之恩了。
至于一旁的李向阳见两人鬼鬼祟祟说了一番话，而杨云帆又说自己师傅是国手名医，他的脸色顿时变了变，心里忍不住吐槽：“尼玛，你师父国手名医，你不早说？害的老子丢人现眼。我就说，哪里来的土包子随手弄弄，就能把檀香的痛经治好！”
至此，他不敢再跟杨云帆较劲。不过，他还是怕陆檀香移情别恋，所以时不时的过来溜达一下，问问陆檀香有什么需求。诸如渴了没，饿了没，等等……像极了乾清宫里的小太监。
可惜，陆檀香的眼睛，至始至终，却是偷偷在瞟杨云帆。
火车一路西行，陆檀香倒是再也没有说痛经的事，反而跟杨云帆请教了一下怎么调理自己身体。
杨云帆本想推脱过去，可是每当陆檀香问一个问题，他脑袋里面便不由自主的跳出一行信息。他这边都没怎么想，嘴巴就脱口而出，完美回答了陆檀香的问题。
火车是从早上8点出发的，路上需要10个小时，到了下午六点钟左右，火车终于到站了。
跟陆檀香分别的时候，杨云帆倒是没有任何不舍，只想着自己下了火车去哪里。二十来年没回来湘潭市了，自己一个人到了这里，人生地不熟的。真没意思。
至于陆檀香，反倒是对杨云帆有些不舍得，也不管杨云帆愿意不愿意，临走之前，她把一张写满了娟秀小字的纸条，塞进了杨云帆的手里，而后就跑掉了。
“什么东西啊？神神秘秘的。”
杨云帆将陆檀香给自己的纸条陆檀香。

He couldn't help but become a little anxious: "Brother, are you so silent?"
He didn't know that Yang Yunfan was struggling at this time.
Dysmenorrhea is a minor problem and can be cured by rubbing the acupuncture points. However, this middle-aged man obviously suffers from kidney yin deficiency. This is not a minor problem and is related to a person's lifelong sexual well-being.
This thing cannot be treated casually, but I don't have that much time to treat him patiently.
After not seeing Yang Yunfan speak for a long time, the middle-aged uncle thought that Yang Yunfan had some request. He hurriedly said: "Brother, I travel all over the country to do business, and I am relatively wealthy. As long as I can cure this disease, I dare not say more, tens of thousands of dollars, I can still afford it."
He stretched out a hand and shook his five fingers, meaning fifty thousand yuan, no problem!
Fifty thousand yuan!
Damn it, grandpa, I met a big fat sheep!
Yang Yunfan's eyes suddenly narrowed and flashed.
Paralyzed, the young man was thrown into the mountains by the old man to hunt for food. He only took a few hundred yuan from the old man a month and did not dare to eat more than one meal of meat.
This damn fat man offered fifty thousand yuan to treat a kidney-breaking problem!
What a fat sheep. If I don’t kill him, I will be sorry for the opportunity God has given me to make a fortune!
"However, when I go to Xiangtan City, I won't be short of the 50,000 yuan."
"I remember that my father established a large enterprise in Xiangtan City. But wait, my father passed away a long time ago... Who is managing this enterprise now?"
Yang Yunfan couldn't remember clearly.
He was only five or six years old when he was taken up the mountain by the old man.
He vaguely remembered that his father was very rich, and his grandfather was even more wealthy.
The old Yang family, whose ancestral home is in Donghai City, was quite powerful in East China.
However, the family business developed rapidly, and gradually it also established a presence in Xiangtan City. At first, his father was in charge of the project in Xiangtan City, and there was also a partner named...Uncle Ye?
Thinking of this, Yang Yunfan deliberately made fun of Qiao and said: "I am not good at studying for your problem, so I don't dare to cure it for you. However, my master is a nationally famous doctor. Treating your problem will be like Zhang Fei eating bean sprouts, a piece of cake!"
Sure enough, as soon as the four words "national famous doctor" came out, the fat man felt extremely proud. That's right, I guessed it right! There is a master behind this little brother. This time, my kidney deficiency was finally cured! Once the kidney deficiency is cured, Fatty, I will go to heaven and earth as soon as possible and order three of the sexiest chicks!
He pretended to be suddenly enlightened and said with admiring eyes: "No wonder you are so capable, little brother!"
So, the fat man respectfully asked Yang Yunfan who his master was and where he practiced medicine.
Yang Yunfan smiled and handed over the old man's address. Anyway, the old man is also a famous doctor in that area, and he is very famous. Seeing that the old man's life seems to be quite difficult, if I give him a rich man to kill him, I can be considered worthy of his kindness in raising and teaching him for so many years.
As for Li Xiangyang on the side, when he saw the two of them talking secretly, and Yang Yunfan said that his master was a famous doctor in the country, his expression suddenly changed, and he couldn't help complaining: "Damn it, your master is a famous doctor in the country, didn't you tell me earlier? It's embarrassing for me. I'll tell you, where does this country bumpkin come from and he can cure Sandalwood's dysmenorrhea by just doing it!"
At this point, he did not dare to compete with Yang Yunfan anymore. However, he was still afraid that Lu Tanxiang would fall in love with someone else, so he would come over from time to time and ask Lu Tanxiang what he needed. Such as are you thirsty, are you hungry, etc... very much like the little eunuch in the Qianqing Palace.
Unfortunately, Lu Tanxiang's eyes were secretly glancing at Yang Yunfan from beginning to end.
The train goes westward, Lu TanxiangHowever, he never talked about dysmenorrhea again, and instead asked Yang Yunfan for advice on how to take care of his body.
Yang Yunfan wanted to shirk the past, but every time Lu Tanxiang asked a question, a line of information popped up in his head involuntarily. He didn't think much about it and just blurted out, answering Lu Tanxiang's question perfectly.
The train departed at 8 o'clock in the morning and took 10 hours on the road. At about 6 o'clock in the afternoon, the train finally arrived at the station.
When he said goodbye to Lu Tanxiang, Yang Yunfan didn't feel any reluctance to say goodbye. He only thought about where he was going after getting off the train. I haven’t been back to Xiangtan City in more than 20 years. I came here alone and was unfamiliar with the place. So boring.
As for Lu Tanxiang, she was somewhat reluctant to let go of Yang Yunfan. Regardless of whether Yang Yunfan was willing or not, before leaving, she put a piece of paper full of Juanxiu's small characters into Yang Yunfan's hand, and then ran away.
"What is it? It's mysterious."
Yang Yunfan gave Lu Tanxiang a note from Lu Tanxiang.
